title: CriptoMonitor
summary: CriptoMonitor is a crypto market monitor for the M5Stack CardputerZero (Debian,
description: CriptoMonitor tracks the cryptocurrency market on the CardputerZero: it features a dashboard of major coins, a search function by ticker symbol, and charts ranging from 1 hour to 1 year. The interface opens in English; press L to switch to Portuguese, and M to view prices in Brazilian reais.
